class_name: 過去-回想-ニキマッテイタ類

provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

glosses: was bound to; was sure to
patterns.usage_note: Looks back on an outcome and declares it a foregone conclusion: of course it was going to turn out that way. It states the speaker's own conviction rather than an evidence-based inference, which makes it blunter than 〜はずだった. 〜てた is the casual contraction of 〜ていた. Beyond the dictionary-form verb licensed here, it also follows nouns and adjectives (嘘に決まってた, 高いに決まってた).

examples.ruby: あんなに練習[れんしゅう]したんだから、勝[か]つに決[き]まってた。
examples.english: After all that practice, of course they were going to win.

examples.ruby: そんな嘘[うそ]、すぐばれるに決[き]まってた。
examples.english: A lie like that was bound to come out right away.

examples.ruby: 準備[じゅんび]もせずに挑[いど]んだんだから、失敗[しっぱい]するに決[き]まってた。
examples.english: Going in with no preparation at all, of course it was going to fail.
